description: One fixed-wing military aircraft is confirmed on outdoor display here by CGN Noticias (2008); which says it is visible from the Centro Histórico. aviationmuseum.eu — a source with a documented record of wrong coordinates and wrong type identifications — is the ONLY source that identifies it as an A-37B and gives the serial "A-404". I have deliberately left tail_number blank rather than propagate an unconfirmed single-source serial. A visit or a dated photograph would settle both the type and the serial in one step.
museum_name: Museo Militar y Ex Fuerte de San José

description: One military helicopter is confirmed on outdoor display here by CGN Noticias (2008). aviationmuseum.eu alone identifies it as a Bell UH-1H and gives "8032/H-113"; a string I cannot parse against any known FAG or US serial convention and cannot confirm; tail_number left blank. Type recorded as UH-1H because the FAG operated the type in quantity and no competing identification exists; but treat the type itself as medium confidence.
